claim: In a Retry retrier, MaxAttempts, the maximum number of retry attempts, is 3 by default; MaxAttempts has a maximum value of 99,999,999.

evidence.quote: A positive integer that represents the maximum number of retry attempts (3 by default). If the error recurs more times than specified, retries cease and normal error handling resumes. A value of 0 specifies that the error is never retried. MaxAttempts has a maximum value of 99,999,999.
